declare

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button number; 
 b_id varchar2(10);
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '01'; -- Initial Creation;
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- IM 6188, 6191, 6192, 6196, 6198, 6199
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 6285, 6341
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 6342
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- IM 6933
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- IM:8497
 --:global.program_version := '07';-- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 -- :global.program_version := '01';
 
 :global.program_version := '02';
 
 set_window_property('win_aaddr',
 title, :banner.prog_name || '[Ver: ' || :global.program_version || ' ]' ||
 ' Alternate Demographics');
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/06/2012. IM 6188, 6192
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 begin
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_street_name');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_suite_apt');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_city');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_state');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_zip');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_usps_id');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_address_1');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_address_2');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_address_3');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_address_4');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_country_name');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_postal_code');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_addr_flag');
 default_value ('', 'global.m_area_code');
 default_value ('', 'global.m_phone_no');
 default_value ('', 'global.other_contact_no');
 default_value ('', 'global.alt_intl_phone_no');
 default_value ('', 'global.preferred_contact_flag');
 default_value ('', 'global.preferred_contact_addr_flag');
 default_value ('', 'global.edit_flag');
 
 go_item('ctrl_block.alt_local_intl_flag');
 
 :ctrl_block.m_area_code := :global.m_area_code;
 :ctrl_block.m_phone_no := :global.m_phone_no;
 :ctrl_block.other_contact_no := :global.other_contact_no;
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_phone_no := :global.alt_intl_phone_no;
 :ctrl_block.preferred_contact_flag := nvl(:global.preferred_contact_flag, 'H');
 :ctrl_block.preferred_contact_addr_flag := nvl(:global.preferred_contact_addr_flag, 'H');
 
 if nvl(:global.alt_intl_addr_flag, '*') = 'Y' then
 :ctrl_block.alt_local_intl_flag := 'I';
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_address_1 := :global.alt_intl_address_1;
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_address_2 := :global.alt_intl_address_2;
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_address_3 := :global.alt_intl_address_3;
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_address_4 := :global.alt_intl_address_4;
 :ctrl_block.alt_country_name := :global.alt_country_name;
 :ctrl_block.alt_intl_postal_code := :global.alt_intl_postal_code;
 if nvl(:global.edit_flag, 'Y') = 'Y' then
 enable_disable_fields('I');
 go_item('ctrl_block.alt_intl_address_1');
 end if;
 elsif nvl(:global.alt_intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'N' then
 if :global.alt_usps_id is not null then
 begin
 select city, state, zip
 into :global.alt_city, :global.alt_state, :global.alt_zip
 from valid_city_state 
 where usps_id = :global.alt_usps_id
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_time + 1) -- Added by Kishore on 01/06/2012. IM 6188, 6192
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('10002');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :global.alt_city := null; -- Added by Kishore on 01/16/2012. IM 6285
 :global.alt_state := null; -- Added by Kishore on 01/16/2012. IM 6285
 :global.alt_zip := null; -- Added by Kishore on 01/16/2012. IM 6285
 end if;
 
 :ctrl_block.alt_local_intl_flag := 'L';
 :ctrl_block.alt_street_name := :global.alt_street_name;
 :ctrl_block.alt_suite_apt := :global.alt_suite_apt;
 :ctrl_block.alt_city := :global.alt_city;
 :ctrl_block.alt_state := :global.alt_state;
 :ctrl_block.alt_zip := :global.alt_zip;
 if nvl(:global.edit_flag, 'Y') = 'Y' then
 enable_disable_fields('L');
 go_item('ctrl_block.alt_street_name');
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if nvl(:global.edit_flag, 'Y') = 'N' then
 disable_fields;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EMAIL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_email(email_addr_in in varchar2) IS
 l_dot_pos NUMBER;
 l_at_pos NUMBER;
 l_str_length NUMBER;
 l_email_addr varchar2(150);
 v_temp VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 l_email_addr := email_addr_in;
 l_dot_pos := instr(l_email_addr,'.');
 l_at_pos := instr(l_email_addr,'@');
 l_str_length := length(l_email_addr);
 IF ((l_dot_pos = 0) OR (l_at_pos = 0) OR (l_dot_pos = l_at_pos + 1) OR
 (l_at_pos = 1) OR (l_at_pos = l_str_length) OR
 (l_dot_pos = l_str_length))
 THEN
 show_error('16189');
 END IF;
 IF instr(substr(l_email_addr,l_at_pos),'.') = 0
 THEN
 show_error('16189'); 
 END IF;
 
 v_temp := ltrim('@', substr(l_email_addr, instr(l_email_addr, '@')+1));
 
 if v_temp is null then
 show_error('16189');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 
END validate_email;
